evidence_slice: The Ebbsfleet Development Corporation (Area and Constitution) Order 2015, S.I. 2015/747, designates three areas lying within Dartford Borough Council, Gravesham Borough Council and Kent County Council as an Urban Development Area and establishes the Ebbsfleet Development Corporation for regeneration of that area. The Government consultation states that the Ebbsfleet, Northfleet and Swanscombe area was intended for a new garden city capable of providing up to 15,000 new homes, supported by up to £200 million of infrastructure funding, and publishes an official boundary map. The statutory instrument took effect on 20 April 2015.
